name: Confirm available prototype cash and terms
goal: Record award or bank evidence and permitted spend
next: Collect existing support documentation and identify the actual cash balance.

name: Freeze the measurement question
goal: Write one testable fault-detection hypothesis and identify safe facility
next: Prepare the short brief and request review only when authorized.

name: Compare equivalent landed supplier offers
goal: Three comparable prices, lead times and written compatibility review
next: Prepare an RFQ with wet loop excluded from initial scope.

name: Obtain independent design and safety approval
goal: Signed design review, approved parts and signed spend release
next: Book review after confirming unrestricted funding and lab access.

name: Validate the fault-triage problem
goal: 30 interviews, 8 documented incidents, 3 qualified pilot opportunities
next: Draft interview invitations and capture anonymized incident evidence.

name: Drill fault cases and validate measurements
goal: Dated calibrated reference logs and safety test sign-off
next: Run the documented bench sequence upon engineering release.

name: Run three EPC-led scoped pilots
goal: Three authorized meter interfaces and reviewable supervised pilot records
next: Agree diagnostic only scope, evidence and exit terms.

name: Prove repeatable contribution margin
goal: Paid pilots, retained accounts and actual support/installation costs
next: Reconcile job cost and annual service terms before hiring.

name: Expand through qualified installer channels
goal: Validated cohort retention, local approval route and funded working capital
next: Review Dubai only after repeatable Hyderabad performance.
